name: AWS Marketplace
description: Access AWS Marketplace directly from Claude to discover, evaluate, and procure cloud solutions. AWS Marketplace MCP helps you find the ideal technology solution from over 30K software, data, and services on AWS Marketplace, compare alternatives, and request private offers from sellers. Get contextual suggestions, relevant insights, and next best action suggestions as your explore AWS Marketplace catalog - all within Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AWS Marketplace to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AWS Marketplace to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://marketplace-mcp.us-east-1.api.aws/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AWS Marketplace MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AWS Marketplace provides these MCP tools: ask_aws_marketplace, generate_aws_marketplace_file_upload_url, get_aws_marketplace_uploaded_files, delete_aws_marketplace_uploaded_file, get_aws_marketplace_recommendations_report, get_aws_marketplace_comparisons_report, get_aws_marketplace_evaluation_report, delete_aws_marketplace_conversation, get_aws_marketplace_solution, get_aws_marketplace_related_solutions, and search_aws_marketplace_solutions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AWS Marketplace?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AWS Marketplace in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does AWS Marketplace MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: AWS Marketplace requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AWS Marketplace is developed by AWS Marketplace. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
